signature: SUBROUTINE ZBDSQR( UPLO, N, NCVT, NRU, NCC, D, E, VT, LDVT, U,

params.name: uplo
params.reference:
-   `= 'U'`: B is upper bidiagonal;
-   `= 'L'`: B is lower bidiagonal.

params.name: N
params.reference: The order of the matrix B. $N \ge 0$.

params.name: ncvt
params.reference: The number of columns of the matrix `VT`. $\mathrm{NCVT} \ge 0$.

params.name: nru
params.reference: The number of rows of the matrix U. $\mathrm{NRU} \ge 0$.

params.name: ncc
params.reference: The number of columns of the matrix C. $\mathrm{NCC} \ge 0$.

params.name: d
params.reference: On entry, the n diagonal elements of the bidiagonal matrix B. On exit, if `INFO=0`, the singular values of B in decreasing order.

params.name: e
params.reference: On entry, the N-1 offdiagonal elements of the bidiagonal matrix B. On exit, if `INFO = 0`, E is destroyed; if $\mathrm{INFO} > 0$, D and E will contain the diagonal and superdiagonal elements of a bidiagonal matrix orthogonally equivalent to the one given as input.

params.name: VT
params.reference: On entry, an N-by-`NCVT` matrix `VT`. On exit, `VT` is overwritten by $P^H \, \mathrm{VT}$. Not referenced if `NCVT = 0`.

params.name: ldvt
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array `VT`. $\mathrm{LDVT} \ge \max (1,N)$ if $\mathrm{NCVT} > 0$; $\mathrm{LDVT} \ge 1$ if `NCVT = 0`.

params.name: U
params.reference: On entry, an `NRU`-by-N matrix U. On exit, U is overwritten by $U \, Q$. Not referenced if `NRU = 0`.

params.name: ldu
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array U. $\mathrm{LDU} \ge \max (1,\mathrm{NRU})$.

params.name: C
params.reference: On entry, an N-by-`NCC` matrix C. On exit, C is overwritten by $Q^H \, C$. Not referenced if `NCC = 0`.

params.name: ldc
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array C. $\mathrm{LDC} \ge \max (1,N)$ if $\mathrm{NCC} > 0$; $\mathrm{LDC} \ge 1$ if `NCC = 0`.

params.name: info
params.reference:
-   `= 0`: successful exit
-   `< 0`: If `INFO = -i`, the i-th argument had an illegal value
-   `> 0`: the algorithm did not converge; D and E contain the elements of a bidiagonal matrix which is orthogonally similar to the input matrix B;  if `INFO = i`, i elements of E have not converged to zero.
